claim_label: Generative AI models rely on training datasets containing copyrighted works.
description: Generative AI models rely on training datasets containing copyrighted works.

instances.assertion: Generative AI models rely on training datasets containing copyrighted works.
Generative AI models are being used to treat biology as a language to design new proteins and predict cellular behaviors for personalized therapies.
Generative AI models are being inserted into many consumer products without explicit user consent.
Generative AI models frequently hallucinate facts and legal citations, leading to real-world legal sanctions.
